### Preparing Data 

```{r}
# Read in packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(gt)
library(viridisLite)
library(terra)
library(geodata)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Reading in data
```{r}
# Read in West Coast data 
wc_EEZ <- sf::st_read(here::here('data/wc_regions_clean.shp'))

# Read in depth raster data 
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')

# Read in yearly annual sst tif files 
rast_08 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
rast_09 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
rast_10 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
rast_11 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
rast_12 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')
```

### Preparing Data

```{r}
# Verify CRS's match 
if (st_crs(wc_EEZ) == st_crs(depth)){
    print('CRS is a match :)')
}else{
    warning('It is not a match:()')
}

# Combine all raster SST rasters 
rasters <- c(rast_08, rast_09, rast_10, rast_11, rast_12)
```

### Process Data 
```{r}
# Calculate average 
avg_sst <- mean(rasters, na.rm=TRUE)

# Converting average SST from Kelvin to Celsius 
avg_sst <- avg_sst - 273.15

# Crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster 
# depth_cropped <- terra::extend(depth, avg_sst)

# Resample depth to match avg_sst
depth_resampled <- terra::resample(x = depth, y = avg_sst, method = 'bilinear')

# Check extent, resolution, and CRS match for both data
if (st_crs(depth_resampled) == st_crs(avg_sst)){
    print('The first matches the second :)')
}else{
    warning('The first does not match the second >:()')
}
# CRS matches 
# Extent matches
# Resolution matches

# CRS matches but EPSG codes do not 
# Reprojecting depth_resampled 
depth_resampled <- terra::project(depth_resampled, avg_sst)

# Stack matching CRS geodataframes
depth_sst <- c(depth_resampled, avg_sst)
```

### Find suitable locations 

```{r}
# Create reclassification matrix for sea surface temp using suitable sea surface temperatures for oysters
rcl_sst <- matrix(c(
    11, 30, 1,
    -Inf, 11, 0,
    31, Inf, 0),
    ncol = 3, 
    byrow = TRUE
)

# Create reclasification matrix for depth using suitable conditions of depth for oysters
rcl_depth <- matrix(c(
    -70, 0, 1,
    -Inf, -70, 0, 
    0, Inf, 0), 
    ncol = 3, 
    byrow = TRUE
)

# Reclassification of SST and depth 
reclassified_sst <- classify(avg_sst, rcl = rcl_sst)
reclassified_depth <- classify(depth_resampled, rcl = rcl_depth)

```

 Finding locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions 
```{r}
oyster_algebra <- lapp(c(reclassified_depth, reclassified_sst), function(a, b) a*b)

```

### Determine the most suitable EEZ 
```{r}
# Rasterize stacked raster for reclassified depth and SST 
wc_raster <- as.factor(rasterize(wc_EEZ, oyster_algebra, field = 'rgn_id'))

# Calculate cell area from wc_raster
area <- cellSize(wc_raster, unit ='km')

# Calculate total suitable area per zone 
suitable_area <- lapp(c(area, oyster_algebra), function(a,b) a*b)

# Create suitablity areas for oyster 
wc_suitability <- zonal(suitable_area, wc_raster, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE, as.raster = TRUE)

```

Mapping
```{r}
# Create map for oyster suitability
tm_basemap('OpenStreetMap') + 
    tm_shape(wc_suitability) + 
        tm_raster(
            col.legend = tm_legend('Suitability Area (km^2)',
                                    position = tm_pos_out('right', 'center'))
    ) + 
    tm_shape(wc_EEZ) + 
        tm_borders(col = 'black',
                    lwd = 0.6,
                    lty = 'solid') + 
    tm_title('Oyster Suitability Analysis') + 
    tm_compass(position = c('left', 'bottom')) + 
    tm_scalebar(position = c('center', 'bottom'))

```
